description:
The Retroid Pocket Nova has a very unique 4:3 screen. It's 1280x960, which is 4x the resolution than you'd see on most retro games. It's also 120hz, allowing for some crazy CRT effects. It's a great handheld for your whole retro library, if not a little overkill...
